title: 上海交大教授：内地与香港市场互补，公司如何选择？
speaker: Yvonne

segments.en: And is it going to come at an expense of Hong Kong because China is now encouraging Hong Kong listed firms to list in China as well? I think so.
segments.zh: 这是否会以香港为代价？因为中国现在也鼓励香港上市公司回内地上市？我认为是的。

segments.en: I think China and Hong Kong have always been playing a fairly healthy, complementary role to each other. In a way, some of the companies choose Hong Kong because Hong Kong has more flexible listing requirements and more liquidity and availability of foreign capital.
segments.zh: 我认为内地和香港一直扮演着相当健康、互补的角色。有些公司选择香港，因为香港上市要求更灵活，流动性更强，外资更易获得。

segments.en: On the other hand, I think China's mainland market enjoys a higher valuation and more liquidity. So in a way, it's a choice of the companies and the financial institutions in which market or which venue fits their needs the best.
segments.zh: 另一方面，内地市场估值更高、流动性更强。所以，公司和金融机构会选择最适合其需求的市场或平台。

segments.en: And we heard from the FX regulator as well about potentially looking into creating offshore RMB FX trading in the future.
segments.zh: 我们还听到外汇监管机构提到未来可能考虑建立离岸人民币外汇交易。
